title: Red Shift
tagline: Change speed, change colour. Only your colour can hit.
controls: Up / Down (W / S) to move, Left / Right (A / D) to brake / boost, auto-fire. Touch: drag on the left to move, tap BRAKE or BOOST
shift: Redshift and blueshift: brake to shift your hue red, boost to shift it blue; your shots only hurt enemies of your hue.
